workflow_roots.output_mechanism: IOutputHandler callback — output is not a file path parameter but routed through handler
workflow_roots.pilot_method_rationale: HTML output is text-readable for automated validation. Most demonstrable format. No special MIME dependencies beyond base EML parsing.
workflow_roots.async_requirement: All methods return Task — example MUST use async/await or .GetAwaiter().GetResult()

non_runnable_types.reason: Concrete implementation of IOutputHandler. Used as dependency by Converter calls, not standalone workflow root.
Abstract interface — not directly instantiable. FolderOutputHandler is the concrete implementation.

repo_provisioning.blocker_description: Target repo aspose-email-net/Aspose.Email.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples does not yet exist
repo_provisioning.severity: HIGH — hard blocker for live PR creation
repo_provisioning.action_required: Maintainer must create GitHub org repo under aspose-email-net org: Aspose.Email.LowCode-for-.NET-Examples with branch main. Classic PAT (ghp_* with repo scope) required in GH_TOKEN env var.
repo_provisioning.pipeline_action: No pipeline change needed — publisher already reads GITHUB_TOKEN; repo owner/repo already configured in email.yml

xml_docs.blocker_description: xml_warning=null — Email HAS XML documentation (unlike Slides). xml_path confirmed present in source-of-truth proof.
xml_docs.severity: NONE — not a blocker. Email XML docs are present.
xml_docs.mitigation: No action needed. xml_warning is null meaning XML docs were found at expected path.
xml_docs.impact: Zero quality impact — LLM prompts will have full docstring context from XML docs.

async_api_pattern.blocker_description: All Converter methods return Task (async) — generated code must use async/await. Standard console app Main is not async by default.
async_api_pattern.severity: MEDIUM — needs explicit handling in code generator and per_type_constraints
async_api_pattern.mitigation: per_type_constraints REQUIRED entries enforce async/await usage. template_hints async_pattern_note documents static async Task Main requirement.
async_api_pattern.action_required: email.yml per_type_constraints must include REQUIRED: static async Task Main and REQUIRED: await Converter.Method(...) entries. Already present in proposed design.

output_handler_pattern.blocker_description: Converter has no file-path output parameter — output routed through IOutputHandler callback. LLM may attempt to pass string output path directly (invalid compile error).
output_handler_pattern.severity: MEDIUM — without per_type_constraints FORBIDDEN entry, LLM will likely generate incorrect code
output_handler_pattern.mitigation: per_type_constraints FORBIDDEN entry: 'FORBIDDEN: passing file path directly as output parameter'. REQUIRED entries enforce FolderOutputHandler usage.
output_handler_pattern.action_required: email.yml per_type_constraints updated with explicit FORBIDDEN on direct file path output

fixture.blocker_description: No pre-existing EML fixture files in official examples repo. Must create programmatically.
fixture.severity: LOW — fully resolved by programmatic approach
fixture.implementation: RFC 2822 raw string as MemoryStream. No Aspose.Email API needed for fixture creation. Confirmed approach in pilot-readiness-design.

semantic_validator.blocker_description: email.yml currently has require_output_validation: false. HTML output validation is feasible and adds quality.
semantic_validator.implementation: Check outputDir contains at least 1 .html file; file size > 0; file content contains 'Hello' (use Contains(), not Equals(), due to evaluation watermark). Can activate require_output_validation: true after first passing run.
semantic_validator.activation_recommendation: Set require_output_validation: false for first pilot run. Enable after first PASS confirmed.

reviewer.severity: NONE — reviewer not required per yml
reviewer.confirmation: Confirmed: require_example_reviewer is false in email.yml. No EXAMPLE_REVIEWER_PATH dependency for email pilot.

dependency_resolution.blocker_description: 7 known deps resolved in discovery run (discovery-email-20260509-121947). dep resolution max_depth=2.
dependency_resolution.risk: MEDIUM — email deps involve cryptography libs. If any are missing at generation time, build will fail. Recommend test run before live PR.

change_5_template_hints.exact_change:
template_hints:
  default_input_extension: ".eml"
  default_input_filename: "input.eml"
  input_creation_lines:
    - 'var emlContent = "From: sender@example.com\r\nTo: recipient@example.com\r\nSubject: Test Email\r\n\r\nHello LowCode Email Converter.";'
    - 'var inputStream = new System.IO.MemoryStream(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(emlContent));'
    - 'var inputName = "input.eml";'
  output_handler_creation_lines:
    - 'var outputDir = "output";'
    - 'Directory.CreateDirectory(outputDir);'
    - 'var handler = new FolderOutputHandler(outputDir);'
  async_pattern_note: "Use static async Task Main(string[] args) — all Converter methods return Task"
  additional_usings:
    - "Aspose.Email.LowCode"
    - "System.IO"
    - "System.Text"
    - "System.Threading.Tasks"

change_6_per_type_constraints.exact_change:
per_type_constraints:
  Converter:
    required:
      - "REQUIRED: using Aspose.Email.LowCode;"
      - "REQUIRED: static async Task Main(string[] args) — all Converter methods return Task, must use async Main"
      - "REQUIRED: await Converter.ConvertToHtml(inputStream, nameWithExtension, handler) — async call with await"
      - "REQUIRED: FolderOutputHandler — concrete IOutputHandler implementation; use new FolderOutputHandler(outputDir)"
    forbidden:
      - "FORBIDDEN: MailMessage.Save() as the primary operation — use LowCode Converter async method"
      - "FORBIDDEN: passing file path directly as output parameter — Converter uses IOutputHandler callback, not string output path"

notes: Email has only 1 WORKFLOW_ROOT type (Converter) — smallest possible scope for a family pilot. Lowest risk expansion candidate.
FolderOutputHandler + IOutputHandler pattern is unique to Email; other families (Words/Cells/PDF/Diagram) all use direct file path output. Requires explicit LLM guidance.
ConvertToHtml is recommended as first method over ConvertToMsg because HTML output is text-readable for validation without binary parsing.
ConvertEmlOrMsg accepts both .eml and .msg input — useful for demonstrating format agnosticism in a second example.
email.yml already has per_type_constraints.Converter with 2 entries — these need to be REPLACED (not appended) with the 6-entry version in yaml_changes_needed.change_6_per_type_constraints.
